items.title: Senior Engineering Design Conference
items.summary: The Senior Engineering Design Conference at Western Michigan University’s College of Engineering and Applied Sciences showcases the work of students from all disciplines. It is an opportunity for students to share fresh perspectives and develop new systems in collaboration with industry partners.
